items.period: Oracle-bone script tradition; approximate late Shang attribution in the file naming/project, not an individually dated artifact
items.caption: A modern redraw of an oracle-script form associated with 雞; early oracle use is reported as a place name, while the animal reading is visible in later textual witnesses.
items.alt: Black single-character vector rendering labeled as an oracle-script form of 雞.
items.selection_reason: Shows the pictographic stage reported by the CUHK account and contrasts with the later compound spelling; the Commons page identifies its ancient-script sources and reusable status.
items.rights: Public domain dedication for this modern SVG redraw, as stated on the Commons file page.

items.source_title: File:雞-oracle.svg - Wikimedia Commons (other versions lists Shuowen seal)
items.period: Shuowen seal-script tradition; early imperial lexicographic form, conventionally Eastern Han account
items.caption: The file page links a separate Shuowen seal-script depiction; Shuowen analyzes 雞 as 隹 semantic plus 奚 phonetic and records 鷄 as a Zhou-script form written with 鳥.
items.alt: The cited Commons file page links a distinct seal-script version in its other-versions list.
items.selection_reason: Useful as a later compound-stage comparison, but the linked version should be retrieved from the file page rather than assumed identical to the oracle SVG.
items.rights: Commons page asserts public-domain status for the SVG representations; confirm the linked version’s own description page before reuse.

limitations.text: The Commons file is a modern vector redraw and is not an ancient artifact photograph. Its page contains links to other forms, but this run did not retrieve a distinct seal-script image URL, so the second candidate is only a linked lead and is not ready for mirroring.
No character-specific Xiaoxuetang query result or usable direct image was available in the browser output; the official CC0 notice therefore supports no selected Xiaoxuetang asset in this response.
